why: An invalid signature must never take the destructive ladder. `corrupt` renames files and tells a learner their data is damaged; these bytes were never installed.

cases.why: EC-PACK-57: a pack archive arrives with an invalid signature.
An invalid signature outranks an integrity failure: nothing was installed, so nothing can have rotted.
Bytes on disk that no verify has ever run over are not installed either.

installCases.why: A wrong key: the signature is genuine, but not ours.
A truncated signature - 32 of the 64 bytes.
A tampered manifest: one flipped bit in the declared defect rate.
A genuine signature over a payload that is not the one that arrived.
